parameters.query:
-- DAY 20 | STEP 5: RETRIEVE OUTSTANDING RETENTION INTERVENTIONS

SELECT
    Intervention_ID,
    CustomerID,
    Intervention_Type,
    Priority,
    Status,
    Assigned_To,
    Created_At,
    Notes,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, Created_At, NOW()) AS Hours_Open
FROM nexus_customer_retention.retention_interventions
WHERE Status = 'In Progress'
ORDER BY Created_At ASC;
